Limitations: Ribbon tab captures cover the top window band only.
Transient popups, dropdowns, native dialogs, and context menus require separate guarded captures.
Global input and screen capture are blocked unless the expected process and window title own the foreground window.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Create or open a sample table/range with values and blanks, enable AutoFilter, then open the active header dropdown with Alt+Down or the header arrow.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Re-check Excel foreground ownership before each setup input and before the dropdown-opening input; discard captures when the expected Excel window or popup is not foreground-owned.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Select Home, open the Number Format combo box, and capture the opened dropdown with the selected format visible.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Re-check Excel foreground ownership before opening the dropdown and before the screenshot.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Select Home, open the Borders dropdown with Alt,H,B, and capture the opened menu.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Re-check Excel foreground ownership before opening the dropdown and before the screenshot.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Select a representative cell and open the worksheet context menu with Shift+F10, the Menu key, or a guarded right-click.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Re-check Excel foreground ownership before the context-menu input and validate the menu belongs to the expected workbook window.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Open File > Open > Browse or the equivalent guarded keyboard path that reaches Excel's native Open dialog.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Treat the native dialog as the expected foreground target after the final launch input; abort if another process or unrelated dialog owns foreground focus.

InteractiveCapturePlan.Trigger: Open File > Save As > Browse or the equivalent guarded keyboard path that reaches Excel's native Save As dialog.
InteractiveCapturePlan.CaptureRequirement: Capture the active popup/dialog/menu bounds, not the owner-window ribbon band.
InteractiveCapturePlan.ForegroundGuard: Treat the native dialog as the expected foreground target after the final launch input; abort if another process or unrelated dialog owns foreground focus.
